question: XRP vs OP: larger % price change on July 23, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
QUESTION: Which of XRP (XRP) or Optimism (OP) had the larger percentage price change on July 22, 2026, according to CoinGecko's daily historical data?

SETTLEMENT RULES:
1. You are an AI judge settling an information market. Determine the correct outcome using the data provided at the time of settlement.
2. For each token, compute the daily percentage change for July 22, 2026 as: (closing price on July 22, 2026 minus closing price on July 21, 2026) divided by closing price on July 21, 2026, times 100. Use CoinGecko's daily closing prices.
3. Use the exact values shown by CoinGecko.
4. The winning outcome is the coin with the larger (more positive) percentage change. This holds even if both changes are negative — the coin that fell less wins.
5. If the two percentage changes are exactly equal at the precision reported by CoinGecko, resolve to "XRP (XRP)".
6. Give your final answer as exactly one of the two outcome labels.

DATA SOURCES: CoinGecko XRP Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/xrp/historical_data); CoinGecko Optimism Historical Data (https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/optimism/historical_data)

POSSIBLE OUTCOMES — select one outcome exactly and output NOTHING else:
XRP (XRP)
Optimism (OP)
